author: KenjiKido
body: It has been a while since I have been on the server due to 70 pages of homework daily and being bored. In addition, my "Revamp Legacy" topic has been awfully neglected. I understand, as that the majority of the server adore Destroy the Monument, and no one sees a need. I have tried Capture the Monument, but am not interested in this game mode. Now, I bet the odds of this suggestion being considered are almost zero, but I would absolutely love a survival game mode. Nothing fancy, just a survival game mode. Maybe add MCMMO, but you don't have to. But if you just give pure survival, that would be fantastic. I don't think it would be very hard to develop this. If you cannot develop this, I completely understand. Thank you all for reading this. Adios! :)
